requiredHumanDrills: Deploy the checkpoint service into an isolated, operator-managed staging environment using the Stage 41 private ingress and mTLS configuration.
Run the staging smoke drill against a synthetic DRILL_STAGE42 encounter and retain the sanitized JSON report.
Perform a PostgreSQL primary failover and confirm the synthetic signed checkpoint remains readable with a new active lease.
Perform a managed PostgreSQL PITR/backup restore into an isolated recovery target; stop all writers and block ingress before lease fencing.
Run the restore fencing utility in dry-run mode, review the report, then apply only after a second operator confirms the restored target and all service writers are stopped.
Restart checkpoint service writers and run the staging drill with the same synthetic encounter ID; confirm the old lease is fenced and the signed checkpoint sequence/envelope is preserved.
Perform Ed25519 verification-key overlap rotation and verify checkpoints signed by the old key remain readable while new checkpoints use the active key.
Run an Unreal Engine 5.8 dedicated-server recovery smoke test against the staging HTTPS/mTLS endpoint and record actual restore outcome.
Execute a multiplayer PIE/reconnect/failure test and validate a packaged Android build on a physical supported device.
Attach representative latency, throughput, capacity, failure and restore evidence to Stage 40 governance before proposing any SLO or production-readiness change.
limitations: CI uses an ephemeral PostgreSQL instance and generated test certificates; it is not a real staging deployment.
The repository does not provision PostgreSQL HA, failover, WAL archiving, PITR, ingress, DNS, CA, secret manager or backup infrastructure.
The restore fencing utility increments epochs and clears leases on every encounter row in its target database. It is an offline operation, not a per-encounter command.
All checkpoint service writers must be stopped and ingress blocked before fencing; ACCESS EXCLUSIVE protects the update transaction but does not prevent an old process from reconnecting afterward.
No Unreal Engine build, dedicated server, PIE multiplayer, Android APK/AAB or physical-device validation is claimed by Stage 42 CI.
Production readiness, high availability approval and Stage 40 SLOs remain false/UNBASELINED until external evidence is reviewed.
